ledger: toothbrush / comb | white handle/head held in right hand at mouth (00:00) | white toothbrush held in right hand near face (00:09) | transforms into a black comb at 00:02 while raised to comb hair, then transforms back into white toothbrush at 00:05 as hand lowers to face

findings.description: The white toothbrush held in the right hand instantaneously transforms into a black hair comb as it is raised to the head, with no visible swap action.
The black comb held in the right hand transforms back into the white toothbrush as the hand lowers from the hair back to the mouth/cheek area.
